# Architecture Best Practices for Compute & HPC

Sign in

## AWS re:Invent 2025

### CEO Matt Garman shares how AWS is shaping the future of cloud tech

Join AWS CEO Matt Garman to hear how AWS is innovating across every aspect of the world’s leading cloud. He explores how we are reinventing foundational building blocks as well as developing brand new experiences, all to empower customers and partners with what they need to build a better future.

Learn more

### AI agents in action: Architecting the future of applications

Explore how agentic AI is transforming cloud-native application architecture, unlocking faster innovation cycles and entirely new application patterns. Learn how new AWS capabilities empower builders to design secure, reasoning-driven agents that orchestrate data, code, and tools at scale, with an emphasis on governance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Discover how AWS customers are deploying production-ready agents today, and learn best practices to help you architect agentic applications that autonomously adapt, optimize, and act in real-time.

Learn more

### Unlocking possibilities with AWS Compute

Join Willem Visser, vice president of Amazon EC2, for an inside look at AWS's transformative compute innovations across instances, containers, and serverless technologies. Willem will explore how customer obsession led to implementing radical new ideas that revolutionized cloud computing, and will be joined by Barry Cooks, vice president of serverless compute services at AWS. Discover how AWS's comprehensive compute capabilities enable you to build, run, and scale breakthrough applications in the cloud and at the edge.

Learn more

### Accelerating Engineering: Cross-Industry HPC Cloud Transformations

This breakout session highlights how AWS HPC is transforming engineering and product development across industries. From accelerating prototyping cycles to scaling semiconductor design, organizations are overcoming traditional on-premises limitations with the cloud. You’ll hear how global R&D teams are leveraging AWS HPC instances, Elastic Fabric Adapter, FSx for Lustre, and ParallelCluster to achieve faster design iterations, reduced time-to-market, and more efficient innovation at scale. Join us to see how AWS empowers engineers and researchers to push boundaries in simulation, design, and development across automotive, semiconductor, and consumer product domains.

Learn more
